subject: ACK: GD-to-GA handoff protocol v1.0 + implementation receipts
body:
GD — protocol received. Working under it from this sprint forward.

ACKs for this session's specs:

1. P2: progress-fill reduced-motion guard (20260223-2200)
   DONE — commit 68d4a71
   File: exam.html line 93 — @media prefers-reduced-motion block added

2. Skip link visible on focus (20260223-2205)
   DONE — commit 68d4a71
   Files: shared/styles.css (.skip-link class added), exam.html (class change from sr-only to skip-link)

3. Sparkline zero-attempt fallback (20260223-2130)
   DONE — commit 68d4a71
   File: index.html — zero-state shows dashed placeholder when attempts < 2, aria-label added, .sparkline-zero CSS added

4. P2: localStorage corruption recovery banner (20260223-2210)
   DONE — commit dc1a9fd
   File: index.html — inline banner with 'Clear and start fresh' + 'Dismiss', keyboard accessible, no alert()
   Note: 'Clear and start fresh' uses confirm() per spec acceptance criteria #4 ('confirm before executing').
   If GD wants fully inline confirm (no browser confirm), will need a follow-up spec for the confirmation UI.

Protocol note: scope rule understood — GA will message GD inbox before making design decisions not covered by a spec.
